summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Beskar IT contact form functionality. All backend APIs working correctly, frontend form integrates properly with backend, saves to MongoDB successfully, and displays appropriate success messages even when email notifications are disabled.
passed_tests: GET /api/health - Returns healthy status with 'This is the way' message
GET /api/contacts - Returns list of saved contacts from MongoDB
POST /api/contact - Saves contact form data to MongoDB successfully
POST /api/contact validation - Properly validates required fields and email format
Contact form response message - Contains correct support email in success message
Email integration handling - Gracefully handles missing Brevo API key (email_sent: false)
Frontend contact form - All form fields present and interactive
Frontend form submission - Successfully submits and shows success message
Frontend form reset - Clears all fields after successful submission
Frontend form validation - HTML5 validation prevents invalid email submission
Frontend navigation - All nav elements present and functional
Frontend UI responsiveness - Mobile menu toggle and responsive elements working
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (7/7 tests), Frontend: 100% (6/6 core functionality tests)
